entries.reviewNotes: Read Japanese metadata, all eleven turns and five hints against all twelve locales. Ice-addition box remains; only other box travels on jointly loaded cart to near line, then receiving staff. Roles, latch check and shallow handle grip agree.

Read Japanese metadata, all eleven turns and five hints against all twelve locales. Two fish split flat, heads removed, individually wrapped to save one tomorrow; thirty-minute trip, ice outside bag and immediate refrigeration preserved. No consequential discrepancy found.

Read metadata, eleven Japanese turns and five hints against all12 locales. Salt-first then cooled dashi tasting, separate hot bowl, breaking one open and dipping individual pieces are preserved; no consequential error found.

Read metadata, eleven Japanese turns and five hints against all12 locales. Wind and individual seasickness uncertainty, unreserved cabin seating, crew-dependent deck access and no procedure before ticket purchase remain explicit.

Read clock exhibition context and all 12 complete sets: large stopped display differs from small demonstration; fourteen-hour return, fifteen-minute explanation, no touching gears, arrow-only model handling preserved.

Read peach-allergy ordering context and all 12 complete sets: syrup contains peach, choose plain sparkling water, no lemon, unopened bottle to open personally, no food order or added allergy guarantees.

Read castle shoe-carrying context and all 12 complete sets: remove shoes at entrance, larger bag, socks permitted, free hand for railing, luggage fit and front positioning preserved without changing source sequence.

Read art-gallery chair context and all 12 complete sets: borrow folding chair, keep passage clear, fold during movement, test carrying weight, avoid pinching fingers and return folded to entrance counter.

Read hat fitting context and all 12 complete sets: smaller hat presses forehead, larger adjusted with inside band, dedicated chin strap sold separately and detachable at both ends, receive attached for windy return.

Read udon dairy-allergy context and all 12 complete sets: ingredient list does not guarantee cross-contact absence, cheese tempura shares frying oil, decline tempura, photograph list and step aside before deciding whether to order.

Read train waiting-room context and all 12 complete sets: next train in two minutes skipped, following in fifteen, platform three via right passage, pace-dependent timing rather than guarantee, depart at least seven minutes early.

Read licence address consultation context and all 12 complete sets: city-hall process separate, only current licence brought, mail left at home, staff determine documents, one party waiting and consultation before later application.

Read medication-label context and all 12 complete sets: morning/evening uncertainty with skipped breakfast, no self-directed combined doses, seven waking and eleven meal, pharmacist individual guidance, OTC stomach medicine photo and prescriber inquiry.

Read forwarded tax-notice context and all 12 complete sets: old-address notice forwarded, worry about duplicate notice, dispatch records and numbers checked, payment not yet made, tomorrow deadline, ID and responsible-counter handoff.

Read stadium bag-check context and all 12 complete sets: tea bottle opened, spare lid and chopsticks identified, food bag opened, bottle upright to avoid leaking, repack personally then separate ticket checker.

Read brewery hose-cleaning handoff and all 12 complete sets: only tagged hose confirmed finished, connected hose untouched, residual liquid collected, demonstrate handling, designated staff control pressure/chemicals, replace wet gloves and notify before restart.

Read supermarket packing context and all 12 complete sets: bread scanned then separately bagged, heavy milk later, eggs on top with milk, basket to packing table, split cash payment only at this register, basket returned below table.

Read reserved bakery pickup context and all 12 complete sets: Sato four cheese breads, no warming for tonight, two per bag, coworker recipient, product-name labels on both bags and prior payment confirmed.

Read first dental visit context and all 12 complete sets: right back tooth filling lost with no current pain/bleeding, piece retained in case for dentist rather than reception, no medicines, consultation within fifteen-hour departure limit without treatment guarantee.

Read library reservation deadline context and all 12 complete sets: forgotten card means no borrowing today, Tanaka vegetable book held through day after tomorrow, trip then, tomorrow eighteen closing with seventeen-thirty arrival and card/email record.

Read postal form context and all 12 complete sets: contact mobile instead of landline, sometimes unreachable daytime, both old/new room numbers, preferred next Monday forwarding date with handling before start left for staff confirmation.

Read bank surname-change context and all 12 complete sets: new-name ID and old-name passbook, missing old-name document, consultation only, staff check current account name and required documents, workplace submission method referred to workplace.

Read hot-spring departure context and all 12 complete sets: personal red-marked wet towel wrung over changing-room sink, bag closed to protect books, borrowed foot mat returned right basket while own towel taken home.

Read hotel stayover cleaning context and all 12 complete sets: desk papers and bed bag untouched, walkway/washroom only with towels changed, toothbrush avoided, cable cleaned manually without vacuum pulling, incomplete desk/bed recorded and front desk informed.

Read obijime fitting context and all 12 complete sets: obi photo for color, two lengths, blue tied example and self retying, enough end length and flat shape selected, paper to contain tassels, no box for drawer storage.

Read missing side dish billing context and all 12 complete sets: soba served but side dish absent, kitchen confirms, five-minute offer declined for departure, corrected bill only soba and one rice, pay revised amount cash.

Read upright taxi box transport context and all 12 complete sets: model can shift, arrow up, larger roads despite detour, driver secures box and passenger belted, delivery entrance diagram on reverse of guide map, help unloading at stoppable place.

Read dark bat exhibit context and all 12 complete sets: distinct entrance/exit, short visit via right passage and floor lights, photography sign consulted without invented prohibition, read outside first, resting bats observed quietly without long stop.

Read laundry-net selection context and all 12 complete sets: blouse care label requires net, fine/large mesh distinction, loose fit when folded, zipper metal tucked beneath fabric after closing, packaging excludes dryer and clothes removed after washing.

Read mailbox-name and forwarding context and all 12 complete sets: moving next week, label removal not forwarding request, building manager handles label, old lease lasts extra week, preferred move-day start, personally collect earlier mail, both addresses needed.

Read Hannan sandpit borrowing context and all 12 complete sets: yellow bucket and blue shovel, small water amount from adjacent tap, sand removed then both returned to reception with shovel removed from bucket for checking.

Read Blue Line transfer context and all 12 complete sets: remain within ticket gates, right before exit stairs without descending, left branch for Shimin Hall-mae, intermediate information boards and ticket retained until destination without inserting at connection.

Read income certificate year ambiguity context and all 12 complete sets: fiscal year differs from income year, current job began this year but recipient seems to need last year, leave year blank and ask recipient official designation before applying.

Read intake medication form context and all 12 complete sets: OTC stomach medicine box, used yesterday not daily, include patches too, unknown lower-back patch name stated honestly and verified at home for next visit, inform doctor of use.

Read suspicious refund contact context and all 12 complete sets: screen-sharing app not installed, only order number sent, unnamed personal sender, preserve messages and verify through order-page official store contact without using message link.

Read soft clay shipping context and all 12 complete sets: made this morning versus material two-day drying instruction, birthday next week permits postponement, larger box for cushioning and bottom support without pressure on protruding leaf decoration.

Read missing bank account-type context and all 12 complete sets: invoice lacks ordinary/current type, call known office, ordinary confirmed as printing omission, recipient company branch appended, compare number and amount on counter screen before request.

Read split loyalty-point payment context and all 12 complete sets: twelve-hundred yen total, nine-hundred points exhausted, three-hundred cash due, five-hundred handed over and two-hundred change, distinguish zero points from unpaid balance and record both methods.

Read flowerbed walking detour context and all 12 complete sets: ten-minute walk versus twenty-minute remaining watering, building-side route both ways, rain-wet bench avoided despite no sprinkler reach, shop landmark and gravel branch avoided.

Read train delay context and all 12 complete sets: ten-thirty appointment, fifteen-minute departure delay not fixed arrival delay, local may arrive later by destination, choose direct Bijutsukan-mae train and update contact after screen/announcement information.

changes.before: Minuman pertama Anda ingin apa?
changes.after: Untuk minuman pertama, Anda ingin memesan apa?
changes.reason: Use natural Indonesian restaurant question word order for the first drink request.

changes.before: 好的。请慢慢休息。
changes.after: 好的，请慢慢享用。
changes.reason: Restaurant closing invites the guest to enjoy their drink, rather than telling them to rest.

changes.before: घूमने का टिकट यहाँ देखेंगे।
changes.after: यहाँ आपका प्रवेश टिकट जाँचूँगा।
changes.reason: Natural Hindi staff wording identifies the admission ticket and checking action rather than an outing ticket.

changes.before: सामग्री की सूची देख सकते हैं। रसोई साझा है, इसलिए दूसरी चीज़ों का अंश नहीं मिलेगा, इसका वादा नहीं कर सकते।
changes.after: आप सामग्री की सूची देख सकते हैं। रसोई साझा है, इसलिए हम यह गारंटी नहीं दे सकते कि दूसरे खाद्य पदार्थों के अंश इसमें नहीं मिलेंगे।
changes.reason: Clarify Hindi cross-contact disclaimer with natural grammar; preserves inability to guarantee absence of other food traces.

changes.before: Thư gửi đến địa chỉ mới đang ở nhà. Hôm nay tôi chỉ tư vấn thôi cũng được chứ?
changes.after: Thư gửi đến địa chỉ mới đang ở nhà. Hôm nay tôi chỉ xin tư vấn thôi cũng được chứ?
changes.reason: Clarify that the visitor seeks advice; Vietnamese tư vấn alone can cast the visitor as the adviser.

changes.before: Ask from the waiting-room plan which platform the train after the next one uses. Please say it in Japanese.
changes.after: Say you will wait in the waiting room and ask which platform the train after the next one uses. Please say it in Japanese.
changes.reason: Replace unnatural waiting-room plan wording with the intended planned waiting context and platform question.

changes.before: Thank you. I'm not sure whether I should take the morning dose together with my other dose at lunchtime.
changes.after: Thank you. I'm not sure whether it would be all right to take the morning dose all together at lunchtime.
changes.reason: Remove invented other lunchtime dose: Japanese only proposes taking the morning portion together at noon.

changes.before: आपके दिनचर्या के समय के अनुसार फ़ार्मासिस्ट अलग से समझाएगा। क्या कोई और दवा लेते हैं?
changes.after: आपकी दिनचर्या के समय के अनुसार फ़ार्मासिस्ट आपको अलग से समझाएँगे। क्या आप कोई और दवा लेते हैं?
changes.reason: Correct feminine Hindi agreement for दिनचर्या and use respectful pharmacist/visitor address.

changes.before: जी। अंदर पानी की बोतल है। क्या यहीं उसका अंदर का सामान दिखाऊँ?
changes.after: जी। अंदर पानी की बोतल है। क्या यहीं दिखाऊँ कि उसमें क्या भरा है?
changes.reason: Use natural Hindi for showing bottle contents rather than the awkward inner belongings construction.

changes.before: Tôi tặng đồng nghiệp ở chỗ làm. Có thể ghi tên lên túi để biết có phô mai không?
changes.after: Tôi tặng đồng nghiệp ở chỗ làm. Có thể ghi tên sản phẩm lên túi để người nhận biết bánh có phô mai không?
changes.reason: Clarify that the requested name is the product name, not the recipient name, as confirmed by the next label offer.

changes.before: Vâng. Miếng trám bị rơi. Hôm nay tôi không có nhiều thời gian nên trước hết chỉ muốn tư vấn.
changes.after: Vâng. Miếng trám bị rơi. Hôm nay tôi không có nhiều thời gian nên trước hết chỉ muốn xin tư vấn.
changes.reason: Use xin tư vấn so Vietnamese clearly portrays the patient requesting advice rather than providing it.

changes.before: ဒီဘက်မှာလည်း သန်ဘက်ခါအထိလို့ မှတ်တမ်းရှိပါတယ်။ အဲဒီနေ့မတိုင်မီ လာနိုင်မလား။
changes.after: ဒီဘက်မှာလည်း သန်ဘက်ခါအထိလို့ မှတ်တမ်းရှိပါတယ်။ အဲဒီနေ့နောက်ဆုံးထားပြီး လာနိုင်မလား။
changes.reason: Preserve inclusive Japanese deadline that permits arrival on that day, rather than requiring arrival before that day.

changes.before: Cho tôi chỉ tư vấn thôi. Tên người nhận chuyển khoản nộp cho chỗ làm hiện cũng vẫn là họ cũ sao?
changes.after: Cho tôi xin tư vấn thôi. Tên người nhận chuyển khoản mà tôi cung cấp cho chỗ làm hiện cũng vẫn là họ cũ sao?
changes.reason: Use natural Vietnamese advice request and clarify provision of account recipient name to employer.

changes.before: একটি ব্যাগ দিন। ব্যাগের ভেতরের বই যাতে না ভেজে চাই।
changes.after: একটি ব্যাগ দিন। আমি চাই ব্যাগের ভেতরের বই যেন ভিজে না যায়।
changes.reason: Repair unnatural Bengali clause order while preserving purpose of protecting books from the wet towel.

changes.before: Tôi xin thanh toán cho anh. Đây là phiếu tính tiền.
changes.after: Tôi xin làm thủ tục tính tiền cho anh. Đây là phiếu tính tiền.
changes.reason: Staff process the bill rather than pay on behalf of the customer; clarify Vietnamese payment role.

changes.before: It's at the back on this map. When we arrive, could you help me take out the box somewhere we can stop?
changes.after: It's on the reverse side of this guide map. When we arrive, could you help me take out the box somewhere we can stop?
changes.reason: Preserve map reverse-side reference instead of asserting entrance is at the back of the building.

changes.before: Ada di sisi belakang pada denah ini. Sesampainya di sana, bisakah Anda membantu mengeluarkan kotaknya di tempat yang memungkinkan untuk berhenti?
changes.after: Gambarnya ada di sisi belakang lembar denah ini. Sesampainya di sana, bisakah Anda membantu mengeluarkan kotaknya di tempat yang memungkinkan untuk berhenti?
changes.reason: Clarify that the diagram is on the back of the map sheet, rather than a building location.

changes.before: នៅខាងក្រោយអគារលើផែនទីណែនាំនេះ។ ពេលដល់ តើអាចជួយខ្ញុំយកប្រអប់ចេញនៅកន្លែងឈប់បានទេ?
changes.after: រូបបង្ហាញនៅផ្នែកខាងក្រោយនៃសន្លឹកផែនទីណែនាំនេះ។ ពេលដល់ តើអាចជួយខ្ញុំយកប្រអប់ចេញនៅកន្លែងឈប់បានទេ?
changes.reason: Remove invented behind-building location; Japanese points to reverse side of guide map.

changes.before: केवल नाम के संकेत से नए पते पर डाक भेजना शुरू नहीं होता। सूचना देने का मार्गदर्शन देता हूँ।
changes.after: केवल नाम की पट्टी हटाने से नए पते पर डाक भेजना शुरू नहीं होता। सूचना देने का मार्गदर्शन देता हूँ।
changes.reason: Restore the contextual action of removing the name label, rather than vague Hindi name signal wording.

changes.before: Shimin Hall-mae ဘက်လို့ရေးတဲ့ ဘယ်ဘက်ပါ။ လမ်းကကြော်ငြာဘုတ်တွေမှာလည်း ဦးတည်ရာစစ်နိုင်ပါတယ်။
changes.after: Shimin Hall-mae ဘက်လို့ရေးတဲ့ ဘယ်ဘက်ပါ။ လမ်းတစ်လျှောက်က အချက်အလက်ပြဘုတ်တွေမှာလည်း ဦးတည်ရာစစ်နိုင်ပါတယ်။
changes.reason: Japanese station notice boards provide destination information, not advertising billboards; correct Burmese board terminology.

changes.before: 我今年才开始目前的工作。提交方似乎想了解去年的收入。
changes.after: 我今年才开始目前的工作。接收证明的单位似乎想了解去年的收入。
changes.reason: Correct recipient role: Japanese 提出先 is the institution receiving the certificate, not the submitting party.

changes.before: 我今年才開始目前的工作。提交方似乎想了解去年的收入。
changes.after: 我今年才開始目前的工作。收件單位似乎想了解去年的收入。
changes.reason: Correct recipient role using natural Traditional Chinese for the institution receiving the certificate.

changes.before: जन्मदिन अगले हफ़्ते है। आज नहीं भेजूँगा, सूखकर लाऊँगा। डिब्बे की बात करें तो यह आकार काफ़ी है?
changes.after: जन्मदिन अगले हफ़्ते है। आज नहीं भेजूँगा, इसे सूखने के बाद लाऊँगा। डिब्बे की बात करें तो यह आकार काफ़ी है?
changes.reason: Hindi सूखकर implies the speaker dries; make the clay object explicit as the thing that dries before return.

changes.before: हाँ। पॉइंट शेष शून्य होगा। यह प्रदर्शन ठीक हो तो पक्का करूँगा।
changes.after: हाँ। पॉइंट का शेष शून्य होगा। स्क्रीन पर दिख रही जानकारी सही हो तो मैं पुष्टि कर दूँगा।
changes.reason: Use natural Hindi for transaction screen information rather than प्रदर्शन meaning performance or exhibition.

changes.before: हो। पोइन्ट शून्य हुन्छ। यो प्रदर्शन ठीक भए निश्चित गर्छु।
changes.after: हो। पोइन्टको मौज्दात शून्य हुन्छ। स्क्रिनमा देखिएको विवरण ठीक भए पुष्टि गर्छु।
changes.reason: Use natural Nepali transaction-screen wording instead of प्रदर्शन, which suggests a performance or exhibition.

changes.before: अभी प्रदर्शन प्रस्थान की देरी है। रास्ते की स्थिति से आगमन की देरी बदल सकती है।
changes.after: अभी स्क्रीन पर प्रस्थान की देरी दिखाई गई है। रास्ते की स्थिति से आगमन की देरी बदल सकती है।
changes.reason: Replace unnatural प्रदर्शन with explicit screen display of departure delay.

changes.before: अहिलेको प्रदर्शन प्रस्थान ढिलाइ हो। बीचको अवस्थाले आगमन ढिलाइ बदल्न सक्छ।
changes.after: अहिले स्क्रिनमा प्रस्थानको ढिलाइ देखाइएको छ। बाटोको अवस्थाले आइपुग्दाको ढिलाइ बदल्न सक्छ।
changes.reason: Use natural Nepali for screen information and preserve distinction between departure and arrival delays.

scope: AI Japanese context and all12 sentence/task sets; native/source/device approval separate.
